narrative.overview: The system is a bobbin-lace pillow. A deep green cloth carries a faint grid of pin holes. Ivory thread braids are drawn in SVG with real over/under crossings. Brass pins hold small ivory-bordered photographs to the cloth. Light sections are pale green "papelão" or flat sage. The pinned brief palette was a starting point; cream and terracotta were dropped as the user rejected them as generic.
keyCharacteristics: Green cloth with pin-dot grid, never flat black or white.
Ivory thread as the only line motif; brass as the only warm accent.
Photos are pinned prints with ivory borders, never rounded frames.
Hairline rules with a small brass dot at the start, like a pin on a thread.
Self-hosted type: Gilda Display, Hanken Grotesk, Herr Von Muellerhoff.

rules.name: The One Warm Thing Rule
rules.body: Brass is the only warm hue. It appears as pins, rule dots, signature script and focus. No second warm accent.

rules.name: The Cloth-Not-Page Rule
rules.body: Dark sections are the default surface. Light sections are papelão or sage, never white or cream. Pure white appears only inside form fields and button hover.

rules.name: The Sage-Contrast Rule
rules.body: On sage, secondary text uses #2D3A31 or #223228, not soft ink or ivory.

rules.name: The Signature-Only Script Rule
rules.body: Script appears at most twice per page, as a signature word. Never for headings, labels or buttons.

rules.name: The Weight-400 Serif Rule
rules.body: Gilda has one weight. Hierarchy comes from size and color, never from faux bold.

rules.name: The Pinned-Print Rule
rules.body: A photo is an ivory print (10px to 12px border), a brass pin at top center, a slight tilt, and one of the print shadows. On hover it straightens and lifts 6px.

dos: Do start dark: pano green with the ivory 30px pin-dot grid, then alternate papelão and sage.
Do draw rules, rows and dividers as hairlines with a brass dot at the left end.
Do keep every photograph an ivory-bordered print with a pin and a slight tilt.
Do use verde (#354A3D) for CTAs on light grounds, ivory buttons on cloth.
Do use Gilda only at weight 400 and script only for a signature word.
Do keep touch targets at 44px minimum and focus rings at 3px.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: show final states, remove draw animation.
donts: Don't use cream, white or terracotta as a section ground or accent. They were tried in the brief and rejected.
Don't add pills, arches, blobs, round photo frames or icon tiles.
Don't add a second warm accent next to brass.
Don't set secondary text on sage in soft ink or ivory.
Don't use script for headings, buttons or more than a signature word per block.
Don't replace hairline rows with equal rounded cards.
